desc:
Undertale: Judgement Day is a Sans vs. Chara type game. A team of humans fights against one monster and try to defeat them. Players can collect wins to buy new monsters, weapons, souls, and armors to become more powerful. You can also buy monsters and level them up through an evolution system to make them become very powerful. Thanks for playing!

Owners: TomatoTrap/WeegeeEZ

Credits to Toby, the creator of Undertale
Credits to all AU owners and music composers

Warning: This game contains bright, flashing lights
